body: 马斯克称赞谷歌AI；OpenAI合并聊天与工作工具；AI可从照片中识别银屑病

特斯拉和SpaceX创始人埃隆·马斯克近日在社交媒体上公开赞扬了谷歌的AI技术，称其在自然语言处理和多模态能力方面取得了显著突破。他表示，谷歌的最新模型展现出的理解和生成文本的能力令人印象深刻，这标志着人工智能竞争格局的进一步演变。与此同时，OpenAI宣布将其旗下的聊天机器人与生产力工具套件正式合并，旨在为企业用户提供更无缝的工作流体验，让用户能够在聊天界面中直接访问文档编辑、表格计算等功能。在医疗健康领域，研究人员开发出一种基于深度学习的AI系统，能够通过分析患者皮肤照片，以高精度识别银屑病等皮肤疾病的早期迹象，这有望为慢性皮肤病的快速筛查和远程诊断提供新的技术手段。
zh.context: 科技企业在提升AI功能的同时面对算力和成本压力，医学影像AI的实际应用正加速落地

problemsFixed: Facts 4 and 5 in the 'facts' array are unsupported or invented. Fact 4 claims OpenAI plans to bring limits 'more broadly in December' per its support page, but Source S2 only states plans to bring limits broadly in December without citing a support page. Fact 5 cites 93.3% severity accuracy for ChatGPT-5, but Source S3 states 93.3% accuracy only for ChatGPT-4o identifying psoriasis, while ChatGPT-5 achieved 93.1% identification accuracy and 93.3% severity assessment — the draft reverses these figures and attributes the 93.3% severity figure to the wrong model.

The 'body' contains evaluative framing: 'The company plans to bring shared usage limits more broadly in December, per its support page, as it faces mounting infrastructure costs and growing demand for capable models' — this inserts causal reasoning ('as it faces') not in the source.
The 'context' field is evaluative ('Tech companies are under pressure to balance AI capability with computing resource constraints') and not directly sourced.

The dek ('Elon Musk praises Google AI; OpenAI merges Chat and Work with limits; AI identifies psoriasis from photos') is 85 characters, which is acceptable, but the body summary sentences risk repeating facts already in the dek.
